remarks:
Discover exceptional living at Hamlet Meadows, a brand-new Marrano Homes community in Lancaster. This exclusive neighborhood features a thoughtfully curated collection of beautifully designed ranch and two-story single-family homes, ideally located off Harris Hill Road, just south of Wehrle Drive, offering convenient access to shopping, dining, parks, and major commuter routes.

This stunning home is designed for modern living, featuring 9-foot ceilings throughout the first floor, a private home office, and a spacious, open-concept kitchen with a large center island and an inviting sunroom that fills the home with natural light. Upstairs, you'll find four generously sized bedrooms, a convenient second-floor laundry room, and a luxurious primary suite complete with a spa-inspired bath, creating the perfect private retreat. Home is move in ready, Taxes are TBD.
